name: 🏰MEDIEVAL⚔️ Museum Tycoon!
desc:
✨Check out the new William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common!

👋Welcome to Museum Tycoon with the Museum of Science! You’ve visited museums. Now you get to build one. 🏛️
Explore two full floors of the real-life Museum of Science's Blue Wing and shape your own museum — filled with exhibits that spark curiosity and reward discovery. 

🦖Unlock new exhibits to increase your income! 
🤑Collect money from kiosks inside your museum!
🚗Purchase cars to explore the map and other players' museums!

Build and explore:
• Colossal Fossil🦖
• Exploring AI🤖
• Arctic Adventure❄️
• Gaia Globe🌍
• Virtual educators and STEM minigames🎓

🌟💰Your tycoon earns money while you're away! Join back to collect your money!

🤗Join our group and favorite the game for updates on Musem Tycoon!⭐️
